entities.title: Work on Shatterbelt
entities.summary: Install, test and build the game in its folder.
steps: npm test (typecheck, then the engine rules, whole-game simulations, replays, lockstep and sign-in suites)
npm run build (into dist/games/retro/shatterbelt/; BASE_PATH="" builds at the root)
npm run dev rebuilds on change

entities.title: Run the Worker locally
entities.summary: The game, its API and a local copy of the database on localhost.
steps: npx wrangler d1 execute shatterbelt-scores --local --file worker/schema.sql
npm run build && npx wrangler dev
entities.verify: The title screen appears and a game alone can be launched, once signed in.
entities.details: The page needs a sign-in. This Worker does not answer /auth/… itself (on icelander.net the site's Worker does), so locally a signed-out visit is redirected to an /auth/sign-in that nothing answers; the library accepts a stand-in session cookie only with DEV_SIGN_IN set to "true" on a local host. See the backlog item local-sign-in. An online game also needs the games hub on the same origin, from its own repository.

entities.title: Change the database
entities.summary: A schema change is a migration applied by hand before merging.
steps: Add games/shatterbelt/worker/migrations/NNNN-what-it-does.sql, numbered from 0002 (schema.sql is the first), with a comment saying why; Shatterbelt has no migrations yet
Make the same change in worker/schema.sql
Try it locally: npx wrangler d1 execute shatterbelt-scores --local --file worker/migrations/<file>
Apply it to production before merging, and say so in the pull request's description
